departments.name: Receiving

tags.text: Channels: Incoming WOs - CA, Incoming WOs - WA

departments.when: Post when a customer job or purchased material arrives at the dock. Before anything is opened or moved to inspection. Shipping later pulls the "how it arrived" photo from this post. 963 posts in the export.

blocks.title: Main post: customer parts
Main post: PO arrived before the parts
Comment: when the parts land
Main post: purchased materials
blocks.body:
ARRIVED: MM/DD @ HH:MM am/pm
VENDOR NAME:
ITW #:
QPC PO: {PO}
PACKAGING: # of packages + type
ITEM(S) SUMMARY:
RECEIVED BY: @{TECH}
#PURCHASING

side.heading: Required photos
items: Packaging condition of the box(es) as they arrived
Big shipping label clearly visible on the package
Packaging condition of the parts inside the box(es)

items.html: Mark EXPEDITE in the priority line when the PO or office says so. Include the fee.
If a PO is missing or pending, write PO: PENDING. Do not leave it blank.
Note partial receipts (only 3 of 5 received) in NOTES and @mention the office.
Do not open sealed customer packaging for the photo. Photograph as received.

departments.source: Viva Engage export: 853 Incoming WOs - CA posts and 110 Incoming WOs - WA posts (Dec 2023 to Feb 2026). "ADVANCED PO" and the "3 BOXES" comment are how receiving posts today. ARRIVED, PACKAGING and RECEIVED BY come from "VIVA ENGAGE NOTES – RECEIVING POSTS FORMAT" (2024) and the retired Expedites channel. No controlled 2026 guideline doc exists for this channel.

departments.name: Inspection (Receiving Inspection)
departments.when: Post at the start of inspection. Your post must let the office verify the job from the post alone. The quality of these posts is a KPI for receiving inspection. 338 posts in the export; real posts follow the guideline closely.

blocks.title: Main post (cover post for the job)
Comment: one per line item
blocks.body:
LINE: {LINE}
PN: {PN} REV.
JOB NO / HEAT LOT / WO NO:
S/N: (range, e.g. DE9048-DE9131)
ID: ____"  OD: ____"  L: ____"  (or L x W x H)
QTY: {QTY} VERIFIED (note any extra or missing pcs)

blocks.html: Found a problem? Do not describe it here. Report it in the Teams NCR - CA channel using the NCR format in the NCR section, then tag the NCR number in this post.

side.heading: Required photos: main post
items: Overall image(s) of how the job was received: trays, containers, packaging

side.heading: Required photos: each line item
items: Part with traceability label in frame
Part with a ruler showing dimensions
Close-up of critical markings (serial, lot, heat)

items.html: Include every identifier on the part: job no, heat lot, S/N, WO. All of them.
Measure every line item. Lab and shipping pull dimensions from this post.
Do not skip measurements because the part looks standard. Lab has had to re-measure parts that were never measured here.

departments.source: "VIVA ENGAGE POSTING GUIDELINES FOR RECEIVING INSPECTION" (rev. Nov 6, 2025; also filed in the Inspection SharePoint site). Field wording and the GENERAL NOTES convention (inspection %, qty verified, caps, condition) taken from real Inspection posts, Feb–Apr 2026. NCR routing updated per Aug 19, 2026 directive.

departments.name: Pre-Clean
departments.when: Post when you receive the job from receiving inspection, before processing. Update with comments as batches complete, pause, and resume. Edit the end time in when the last batch is done.

blocks.title: Main post
Comment 1: completed line / batch
blocks.note: one per line item or batch

blocks.title: Comment 2: job paused
blocks.body:
JOB PAUSED
Reason:
Pause Time: HH:MM am/pm

blocks.title: Comment 3: job resumed
blocks.body:
JOB RESUMED
Start Time: HH:MM am/pm

blocks.title: Comment: pre-clean inspection

side.heading: Required photos
items: How the job was received from the previous department, and the parts before processing (main post)
Completed processed parts with traceability labels in view (each line/batch comment)
Completed router, full page, before it goes to the pre-clean inspector. Both pages if there is a back page.
Inspector: router once inspected and stamped, before it goes to cleanroom

items.html: If the job goes STRAIGHT TO CLEANROOM, write the reason in General Notes.
Inspection posts must carry a verified quantity.
Rejected pieces sent back: supervisor documents the rejection, names the pieces, and the reclean gets a new post and new router.
Do not post a finish time without a finish photo and traceability labels. That was the most repeated pre-clean mistake.

departments.source: "PCL Template" (Oct 10, 2025), matched against 160 real Pre-Clean posts in the export (Feb 2026). The inspector comment is what pre-clean inspection actually posts ("Verified qty 4" plus the WO tag), with the router photo line added per the Aug 26, 2026 directive. Two-page router and reclean rules from Sep 4, 2026 action items.

departments.name: Cleanroom
departments.when: Main post when the batch starts in the cleanroom. Then one comment per line item, one comment per process step with its photo, and COMPLETE at the end. Edit the end time into the main post. 617 posts in the export; the cleanroom lead confirmed the format on Feb 26, 2026.

blocks.title: Main post
Comment: one per line item
Comments: one per process step, photo attached
blocks.body:
WET WIPE / IPA
HAND WIPE
LIGHT GN2 PURGE
BLACKLIGHT PASSED
IN OVEN AT HH:MM, SET AT ___°
COMPLETE

blocks.title: Comment: cleanroom inspection

blocks.html: Serialized parts: list every serial number in the line-item comment. Missing serials in the post caused a customer corrective action request in Jan 2026 (Performance Sealing, WO 40625).

side.heading: Required photos
items: Main post: parts as received into the cleanroom, labels in view
One photo per process-step comment (wipe, purge, blacklight, oven)
COMPLETE comment: finished parts with traceability labels and serial markings legible
Completed router, full page, before it goes to the cleanroom inspector
Inspector: router once inspected and stamped, before it goes to packaging

items.html: Write the special instruction out. "NONE APPLY" is acceptable when that is true. A bare YES is not.
Assembly jobs: update progress and status in comments. Do not go silent for days.
Missing a serial or a piece? Comment and @mention the final inspector immediately.
Dew point on ULA/Sauer jobs is recorded on the router, and the router photo has to show it.
Do not batch multiple WOs in one post. One WO per post.
Real posts in the export average one photo on the main post. That is below the standard. Every step gets its own photo.

departments.source: Viva Engage export, Cleanroom channel: 617 posts Mar 2024 to Aug 2026. Main post and comment formats are the most complete and consistent 2026 posts in the channel; other cleanroom techs use the same fields. The cleanroom lead confirmed the format Feb 26, 2026. No controlled cleanroom guideline document exists. Router photo rule from Aug 26, 2026.

departments.name: Lab Testing
departments.when: Main post when testing starts on a batch. One comment per line item with part and serial numbers, one comment per test or gauge with its photo, then COMPLETE or PENDING APPROVAL. Edit the end time into the main post. Solvent distilling runs also post here.

blocks.title: Main post
Comment: one per line item
Comment: one per test / gauge, photo attached
blocks.body:
LINE: {LINE}  QTY: {QTY}
TEST: Particle / NVR / UV / VC / Dew Point / Pressure / Gauge ID ____
SPEC / LEVEL:
READING / RESULT: PASS / FAIL (numbers)
COMPLETE AT HH:MM   or   PENDING APPROVAL

blocks.title: Main post: solvent distilling run
blocks.body:
DISTILLING IPA / ETHYL ACETATE
Day: MM/DD/YYYY
Start Time: HH:MM am/pm
End Time: HH:MM am/pm (edit in when done)
BATCH ID:
TECH: @{TECH}

side.heading: Required photos
items: Part with traceability label in view (main post)
Measurements: ruler or caliper on the part, legible (line-item comment)
Test setup and readings: gauge, counter, meter display (test comment)

items.html: If inspection never measured the part, measure it, post the measurement and photo here, then flag it to the inspection lead.
A FAIL, scratches, a broken cap: comment it here and report it in Teams NCR - CA. Tag the NCR number.
Distilling runs: the spreadsheet log stays Incomplete until the photo post is up.
Do not post "tested, passed" with no readings and no photos.

departments.source: Viva Engage export, Lab Testing channel (Jan–Apr 2026): per-line and per-gauge comments on WIKA 42279, PCC Rollmet 42235 and Systima 42242-1, LAB BATCH posts, and a distilling run post. Measurement line added per the Jul 14, 2026 correction. No controlled lab guideline document exists. Only 15 posts were in the export, so confirm the field set with the lab lead.

departments.name: Packaging
departments.when: The packaging tech's own post, separate from Packaging Inspection. Main post when bagging starts. One comment with a photo for each layer as it is completed, one comment per line item, then COMPLETE. The inspector posts separately in Packaging Inspection. 309 posts in the export.

blocks.title: Main post
Comments: one per layer, photo attached
blocks.body:
NYLON COMPLETED AT HH:MM am/pm
POLYETHYLENE COMPLETED AT HH:MM am/pm
CAPS ADDED / FOAM / DESICCANT / HUMIDITY INDICATOR
COMPLETE

blocks.title: Comment: one per line item

side.heading: Required photos
items: Main post: parts as received from cleanroom inspection, labels in view
Each layer as a separate comment photo: nylon bag, poly bag, completed package (since Sep 4, 2026)
Completed router, full page, before it goes to the packaging inspector

items.html: Pause and continue comments with times if the job spans a break or a shift.
Serialized parts: serial numbers in the line-item comment.
Do not post one photo of the finished bag. Each step is its own comment with its own photo.

departments.source: Viva Engage export, Packaging channel: 309 posts Mar 2024 to Aug 2026. Format is the consistent 2026 CA posts; layer comments ("NYLON COMPLETED AT 12:40PM", "POLYETHYLENE COMPLETED AT 1:03PM") are from WA posts. Per-step photo rule from Sep 4, 2026 action items. No controlled guideline document for this channel.

departments.name: Packaging Inspection
departments.when: The inspector's post. Main post when the inspection starts, one comment per line item, then a handoff comment to shipping with the time. These photos represent QPC's work and may be sent to the customer. 834 posts in the export, the busiest channel after Incoming WOs.

blocks.title: Main post (cover post for the job)
Comment: one per line item
blocks.body:
LINE {LINE}
P/N: {PN} REV.
LOT NO / JOB NO / S/N:
QTY {QTY} VERIFIED
SEAL VERIFIED
FOD __ (count of pieces found and removed; 0 if none)
LABEL VERIFIED

blocks.title: Comment: handoff to shipping
blocks.body:
HH:MM am/pm @[shipping lead]
Router inspected and stamped: photo attached

blocks.title: Comments: findings during inspection
blocks.body:
FOD LINE {LINE} (photo attached)
REBAGGED AND LABELED
CAPS WERE ADDED HH:MM am/pm
PENDING LABELS

side.heading: Required photos
items: Overall pictures of the packaged job (main post)
Each packaging step as a separate photo: nylon bag, poly bag, completed package (since Sep 4, 2026)
Packaged parts with traceability labels clearly visible
Seal close-ups
Humidity indicators, desiccant, tamper seals if used
Completed router before the packaging inspector; inspector posts the stamped router before shipping

items.html: FOD is a number. Count what you found and removed, and post the FOD photo as its own comment.
Packaging spec with revision and level goes in the main post.
Special instructions from the traveler: write what applied to packaging, or say it does not apply to PCKI.
Handoff comment with the time and @[shipping lead] is how shipping knows the job is theirs.
Do not post one photo of a finished box and call it done. Each step is shown separately.

departments.source: "VIVA ENGAGE POSTING GUIDELINES FOR PACKAGING INSPECTION" (Dec 29, 2025) and TR-011 Rev. A, reconciled against 834 real Packaging Inspection posts in the export (Mar–Jun 2026 set the wording: FOD count, "DOES NOT APPLY TO PCKI", handoff time to shipping, "REBAGGED AND LABELED"). Per-step photo rule from Sep 4, 2026 action items.

departments.name: Final Inspection
departments.when: Post at final inspection, before shipping approval. The post must let the office verify release from the content alone.

blocks.title: Main post (cover post)
Comment: one per line item
blocks.body:
Line No: {LINE}
P/N: {PN}
Qty: {QTY} (verified complete; matches Traveler, Pack Slip, and Cert)
Condition: verified clean, free of damage, contamination, and FOD
Packaging / Label Verification: correct material, bags clean and undamaged, heat/tamper seals proper, foam padding secured, label placement correct
Shipping Label: correct address and customer
Paperwork Verification: Cert and Pack Slip in shipment
Shake test performed: YES / NO

blocks.html: Shipping Approved means the packaging and boxing check is complete: parts safely packed, labeled, and meeting packaging requirements. It does not authorize shipment. Final Approved means all inspections passed, paperwork is correct, and packaging is fully verified. That is the release to ship.

side.heading: Required photos
items: Main post: overall shipment ready for release, labels visible
Line item: packaged part with traceability label, shipping label, and paperwork

items.html: Cross-check qty against three documents: traveler, pack slip, cert.
If any check fails, the job stays. Report in Teams NCR - CA.
Do not write "Final Approved" if the shake test or paperwork line is blank.

departments.source: "VIVA ENGAGE POSTING GUIDELINES FOR FINAL INSPECTION" (Nov 12, 2025). Note the document's header still reads "Receiving Inspection"; the content is the Final Inspection format.

departments.name: Shipping
departments.when: Main post when boxing starts. One comment per box. Before you start: go to Incoming WOs - CA, download the photo of how the job arrived, and reuse the original packaging if possible.

blocks.title: Main post (cover post for the job)
Comment: one per box
blocks.body:
Box Number: __ of __
Box Dimensions: __ x __ x __
Box Weight: __ lbs (always give an approximate weight for crates and pallets)
Line Items Included:
  Line No: {LINE}
  P/N: {PN}
  Qty: {QTY} (verified per line item)
  Part Identifiers: (S/N, heat lot, job no)

blocks.title: Comment: shipped
blocks.body:
UPS GROUND / FEDEX / WILL CALL picked up by ____
TRACKING NO: ____
SHIPPED HH:MM am/pm MM/DD

side.heading: Required photos: main post (only these 2)
items: Original packaging as received (downloaded from the Incoming WOs - CA post)
Final packaged job: palletized or organized boxes, traceability labels visible

side.heading: Required photos: each box comment
items: Step-by-step progression of the boxing
Box contents with traceability labels visible
Box exterior showing dimensions and labels

items.html: Edit comments after all shipments are complete. There must always be a general note.
Leave the top of the box open on the "Ready for Approval" table. Seal only after final approval.
Everything must match the work order and the shipping requirements.
Do not stack extra photos in the main post. Two in the main post; the rest go in box comments.

departments.source: "07 - SHP - SHIPPING VIVA ENGAGE POST GUIDELINES" (Dec 29, 2025) and "QPC SHIPPING CHECKLIST" (Jan 6, 2026). Checked against 211 real Shipping posts in the export; Feb 2026 posts and box comments follow the guideline, and the carrier and tracking number are added as a comment.

departments.name: Customer Communication / SCR
departments.when: Office and front desk. Post when a customer says something the floor or another department needs on record: pricing questions, approvals, expedite terms, disposition instructions, pickup requests. Quote the customer. Do not paraphrase.

blocks.title: Customer communication post
Comment: reply / disposition
blocks.body:
PER [name, date]: "exact reply"
ACTION TAKEN: (DB updated / labels reprinted / job released / rescheduled to ___)
BY: @{TECH}  HH:MM am/pm

items.html: Quote the customer word for word inside quotation marks with "Per [Name]". That quote is what protects QPC later.
Attach or name the source: the email, the call, the PO line.
@mention who has to act. Department leads acknowledge within 24 hours.
Expedites: post the expedite fee and the agreed date in the post.
Do not summarize a customer decision from memory. If you do not have the exact words, get them first.
Real-time back-and-forth belongs in Teams. Viva is the record of what was decided.

departments.source: Live Customer Communication and SCR posts (2024–2026) and "Training Guide for Front Desk Employee" (Oct 2024). No controlled guideline document; fields reflect consistent practice.

departments.name: Requisition
departments.when: Post when a job or a department needs something bought: job-specific materials (foam plugs, bags, IPA), shop supplies, equipment. Purchasing works from this channel. Post with the WO whenever the item is for a job.

blocks.title: Requisition post

side.heading: Required photos
items: Attach the PO page, spec callout, or F112 requisition form that requires the item, if it is job-driven
Photo of the item or label if reordering an existing stock item

items.html: Spare margin is fine, but say it: "PO reflects 400, added 50% as spare".
Stay ahead of inventory. Post before you run out, not after.
Purchasing replies in a comment when ordered and when received. Received items get an Incoming WOs post with #PURCHASING.
Do not requisition in a Teams chat. If it is not in this channel, it is not on the log.

departments.source: Live Requisition posts (2024–2026) and the Jul 2025 instruction to "post in requisition with the WO". No controlled guideline document.

departments.name: NCR & Escalation
departments.when: Since Aug 19, 2026 all NCR reporting and dispositions happen in the Teams NCR - CA channel. The Viva Engage NCR channel is retired. Viva Engage still holds the department post, the photos, and the movement proof. Tag the NCR number in the department post so both link.

blocks.html: Stop the job first. Do not fix, clean, repackage, move, guess, or continue until the escalation owner replies with a disposition.

blocks.title: NCR report (Teams NCR - CA)
Viva comment on the department post
blocks.note: links the NCR to the job trail
blocks.body:
NCR REPORTED in Teams NCR - CA
NCR #: ____   #NC____
LINE {LINE}  P/N: {PN}
Issue: (e.g. NICKS ON 2 PCS THAT CATCH NAIL; 4 PCS STAINS, ATTEMPTED DRY WIPE / IPA / DI WATER)
Job on HOLD at: (location)
Photos attached
@[NCR owner]

blocks.title: Comment: customer disposition on record
blocks.body:
Per [name]: "exact quote, e.g. Acceptable please proceed"
Disposition: PROCEED / REWORK / RETURN TO CUSTOMER / SCRAP
By: @{TECH}  HH:MM am/pm

blocks.title: Viva photo proof: WO / NCR moved

side.heading: Required photos
items: Issue detail: the discrepancy itself, clear and oriented (damage, missing marking, wrong count)
Traceability: identifiers visible and legible in every NCR photo
Movement proof when the job changes location

items.html: Receiving: Tech → Receiving Inspector → Inspection Lead → Quality Manager
Pre-Clean: Tech → Pre-Clean Inspector → Production Lead → Quality Manager
Cleanroom: Tech → Cleanroom Lead → Final Inspector → Quality Manager
Packaging: Tech → Cleanroom Lead → Final Inspector → SCR2 → Quality Manager
Inspection: Inspector → Inspection Lead → NCR/MRB → Quality Manager
Shipping: Tech → Warehouse Lead → Production Lead → Quality Manager
Customer impact imminent: skip levels, notify the Quality Manager, then the GM if unavailable.
Leads and inspectors answer tech escalations within 10 minutes.
Containment decided within 30 minutes. Standard NCR acknowledged in Teams within 15 minutes, expedite within 10.
Root cause started within 24 hours. Corrective action closed within 5 days.

departments.source: NCR section of the Receiving Inspection guideline; escalation procedure and post format shared Nov 20, 2025; NCR pilot standard formats Jun 27, 2026; channel retirement directive Aug 19, 2026. Issue wording and the "Per [name]: quote" disposition comment are from the 157 real posts in the retired Viva NCR channel (Feb–Jul 2026).

departments.name: Office: escalating a decision

tags.text: Teams, email, or a Viva comment

departments.when: For anyone in the office who owns a type of problem and needs a decision. Reporting a finding is different: anyone reports right away, with facts and photos, and never holds it back to write a brief. The brief is for the person who works the problem before it goes to whoever has the authority to decide it.

blocks.html: Emergency? Customer impact imminent, a safety issue, a part about to ship wrong: skip the format and go straight to the Quality Manager. Paperwork after.

blocks.title: The brief
blocks.body:
WO: {WO}  CUSTOMER: {COMPANY}
FACTS AND CHECKS: (what happened: line, part, qty, where found. What you already looked at: Viva trail, router, DB, prior jobs)
REQUIREMENT: (what the PO, spec or procedure says, quoted)
OPTIONS: (the real ones and what each costs. Name any we cannot take without authorization)
RECOMMENDATION: (one pick, one reason)
UNKNOWNS: (what you could not confirm. A gap beats a guess)
NEED, BY WHEN: (approval, signature or customer call, and the date it is needed)
#WO{WO}

blocks.title: Decision made inside your authority

items.html: Report it. Anyone, right away. Facts, photos, tag the owner.
Work it. The office owner of that kind of problem. The brief.
Decide it. Inside your authority: you, then log it. Outside it: the Quality Manager, with the brief.
Interpreting a customer requirement, or resolving two that conflict
A commercial exception: [price, lot minimum, expedite fee, terms, or over $__]
An MRB or NCR concession, or a disposition request going to a customer
Calling something systemic versus a one-off
Anything your role or a written procedure does not already cover
Quote the requirement. Do not paraphrase it from memory.
Cross off options we are not allowed to take, and say why.
Not sure the call is yours? Send the brief and ask.
Do not use "the answer is obvious" as the test. Your authority is the test.
Do not send a raw problem when there was time to work it.

departments.source: QPC office escalation standard ("Bring me a decision, not a problem"), Sep 2026. Marked proposed until the written authority list per role exists; the commercial exception threshold is still a placeholder.
